s.how: Mix 300g pork mince, 150g chopped prawns, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 3 chopped shiitake and 1 tbsp soy. Spoon into 24 wonton wrappers, pinch up the sides and steam 8 minutes. Top each with a dot of roe.
Mix 200g oats with 50g melted butter, salt and a splash of hot water. Press thin, cut rounds and bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Top with crème fraîche, 150g smoked salmon, dill and lemon.

m.note: the old lodge in the Scottish highlands
m.how: Rub 800g venison backstrap with crushed juniper, thyme and pepper. Sear to rare and rest. Add 60ml whisky, 2 tbsp redcurrant jelly and 150ml stock to the pan and reduce. Mash 600g swede with butter. Roast 800g potatoes.

w.note: a Scottish dessert for the highlands
w.how: Toast 60g oats in a dry pan until nutty. Whip 400ml cream with 3 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp whisky. Lightly crush 300g raspberries. Layer cream, raspberries and oats in four glasses, finishing with oats on top.

d.note: the very old whisky Silva pours on his island
d.how: Simmer 60g honey, 60ml water and a sliced 4cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. For each drink, shake 50ml blended Scotch, 20ml lemon juice and 20ml honey ginger syrup with ice. Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler and gently float 10ml peated single malt on top. Garnish with a piece of candied ginger.
